messages:
sophie: Hey team — running into a TimeoutError on long streaming generations with the Python SDK. It happens ~60s into streaming, even though I set timeout=(5, 600). Using redwood-python 0.9.2. Any ideas?
eli: Can you paste the minimal repro and the exact exception text/logs?
sophie: Sure. Repro below (trimmed):
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=..., timeout=(5, 600))
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model='open-llama-large', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'long essay please'}], max_tokens=2000, stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk)
```
Exception: requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: Stream read timed out after 60s
eli: hmm, 0.9.2 should respect the tuple, but streaming uses a separate idle/read chunk timeout in the streaming loop. Are you setting any REDWOOD_* env vars?
sophie: Not that I know of. I only set REDWOOD_API_KEY.
jordan: Two common gotchas: (1) older SDKs (<=0.9.x) fall back to an internal default chunk/read timeout (~60s) for streaming, ignoring the normal timeout param; (2) if you set a connect/read tuple it maps to urllib3/read timeout but stream internals still enforce their own heartbeat.
maria: We shipped a fix in master that makes stream timeout inherit client read timeout or an explicit stream_timeout param. Patch is in review (PR #1423).
eli: For a quick workaround, set a very large read timeout or set the stream-specific env var: `os.environ['REDWOOD_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT']='1800'` or construct client with `timeout=(5,3600)` — that should prevent 60s cutoff.
sophie: Tried `timeout=(5,3600)` and confirmed generation now continues past 60s. Thanks!
jordan: Another note: env var REDWOOD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (older name) will override client args in some versions; double-check you don't have that in your CI/container image.
support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 auto-linked to thread 1795123456
eli: We'll open an internal support ticket and escalate to eng for a patch release. Can you share exact pip freeze?
sophie: pip freeze: redwood==0.9.2, requests==2.31.0, urllib3==1.26.15
maria: OK thanks. I'll add the precise repro to PR #1423 and target a 0.10.1 hotfix. Eng-oncall, please prioritize if this affects customers using long streaming gens.
eng-oncall: Acknowledged — marking P2 and adding to tomorrow's build.
sophie: Appreciate it. Please keep me posted; the workaround is fine for now but I'd like a proper fix in the release notes so my team can remove the env hack.
jordan: Will include in changelog and note the envvar override behavior. Closing loop once the release is out. :thumbsup:
eli: tagging @maria for follow-up docs update on timeout config (examples for connect/read/stream).
maria: On it, will add examples and a FAQ entry about long generations and streaming chunk timeouts.
sophie: thanks all!
